SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — LCSP-360 disposable mini source. This text is not legislation.

Article 1. MINI-001 — Definitions
Covered Organization means an organization that stores or processes Protected Records. Protected Record means information relating to an identifiable individual.

Article 2. MINI-002 — Base safeguard duty
A Covered Organization that stores Protected Records must maintain documented technical and organizational safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the records.

Article 3. MINI-003 — Qualified review duty
If a Covered Organization processes more than 1,000 Protected Records during a calendar year, it must perform a documented safeguards review at least once every 12 months.

Article 4. MINI-004 — Exception
MINI-003 does not apply where Protected Records are processed solely for a temporary emergency-response activity lasting no more than 30 days. MINI-002 still applies.

Article 5. MINI-005 — Cross-reference
Where MINI-003 applies, the review must evaluate the safeguards required by MINI-002 and document material deficiencies and remediation actions.

Article 6. MINI-006 — Non-repository duty
A Covered Organization must designate a contact for questions concerning its handling of Protected Records and make that contact information available to affected individuals.
